title: Govee RGBIC Floor Lamp Basic, 1000lm LED Corner Lamp Compatible with SmartThings, Alexa, and Matter, Modern Floor Lamp with Music Sync and 16 Million DIY Colors, Standing Lamp for Bedroom Living Room
